_comment: QUARANTINE for scripts/check-recompute-equality.mjs (§18 recompute-equality, STANDING ORDER #34).
Every entry is a NAMED node with an OBSERVED cause. This is not a threshold, not a heuristic and not a
classifier — no node is ever excluded by a rule, only by name. Counts only go DOWN: if a quarantined
receipt starts reproducing, the gate FAILS until its entry is deleted, so the list cannot outlive the defect.
WHAT 'does not reproduce' MEANS, stated precisely and without inference: re-executing the node's own kernel
(bytes on disk, in the QuickJS sandbox) over EVERY published conformance vector produces no output that
JCS-equals the receipt's journal.output. That is a demonstrated fact about the published estate. It does NOT
by itself prove which of the possible causes applies — a kernel that moved after proving, a guest that
committed a degraded output, or a proof taken over inputs that were never published as a fixture. Each entry
below therefore records the OBSERVED delta only, plus whether journal.kernel_digest still equals the digest
recomputed from today's kernel source. Adjudicating cause and re-proving is a separate work unit; this gate's
job is to make the condition impossible to ship silently from here on.
Baseline observed 2026-08-11 by ASYNC-VACUOUS-GATE-1 on merged main (chaingraph.json, 588 live nodes):
586 receipts examined minus 5 §25 private-input skips = 581 tested; 561 reproduce; 20 do not, all listed here.
2026-08-11, SIGKERNEL-VERIFYONLY-RECLASS-1: art-124's entry removed. art-124 was reclassified gpu:true
(verify-only, out of the §18.6 profile's scope) and its vacuous compute_proof (journal.output={}) removed
entirely, so it is no longer a candidate this gate examines (candidates = live nodes carrying a compute_proof).
A quarantine entry naming a node the gate does not examine fails the gate by design; removing it is the fix,
not a widening of what counts as reproducing.
2026-08-14, ETHMATH-ASSEMBLE-LAND-1: art-284's entry removed. ART284-REPROVE-0812-1 re-proved art-284 against
the noble Ed25519 kernel, replacing the vacuous receipt (journal.output={}) with one whose journal.output
carries 6 real keys and whose journal.kernel_digest equals the digest recomputed from today's kernel bytes.
The receipt now reproduces, so the entry had to go in the same push that assembled it — a reproducing node
still listed here fails the gate by design. Same shape as art-129 leaving this list in ASSEMBLE-LAND-BATCH-0811-B.
